answer_1.quote: We present a paradigm that considers the problem of word sense extension (WSE) illustrated in Figure . Given a novel context and an intended meaning, a speaker wishes to choose an existing word in the lexicon to express that meaning which the word has never been used to convey.
answer_1.outputs: The extension of word meanings to novel senses in natural context, such as metaphorical or metonymic uses.

answer_2.quote: We quantify model performance with two metrics: 1) the mean precision is the percentage of cases where a model correctly predicts the groundtruth source token as the most likely candidate, and 2) the mean reciprocal rank (MRR-100) is the averaged multiplicative inverse of the ranks of the ground-truth source tokens in all evaluation examples.
